Apologies for the delay.

The proposed rates are:

15 August – 15 September: AED 7,500
15 September – 15 October: AED 8,500
15 October – 15 November: AED 9,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).
